tabs.html:
MikroTik hEX S (RB760iGS) – Advanced Gigabit Ethernet Router

High-Performance & Versatile Networking Solution

The MikroTik hEX S (RB760iGS) is a powerful and cost-effective wired router, designed for home users, small businesses, and enterprise networks. Featuring a dual-core 880MHz CPU, 256MB RAM, and 16MB Flash storage, this router delivers exceptional speed, stability, and efficiency for modern networking demands.


With five (5) Gigabit LAN ports, one (1) SFP port for fiber connectivity, and one (1) USB port, the hEX S ensures superior network performance. Additionally, PoE-out on port #5 provides power to other devices, making it an ideal choice for professional networking setups.


Key Features 

  • High-Performance Dual-Core Processor – Equipped with an 880MHz dual-core CPU and 256MB RAM for fast and stable network operations.
  • 5 x Gigabit LAN Ports – Supports high-speed wired connections, ensuring smooth data transfer and device communication.
  • 1 x SFP Port – Enables fiber-optic connectivity, offering superior speed and low-latency networking.
  • PoE-Out on Port #5 – Powers compatible devices like IP cameras and wireless access points, reducing cable clutter and additional power sources.
  • USB Port for Extra Connectivity – Supports external storage, modems, and other USB devices.
  • RouterOS L4 License – Includes advanced networking features, such as firewall, VPN, bandwidth control, and QoS.
  • Reliable Flash Storage – Comes with 16MB Flash storage for firmware updates and custom configurations.
  • Compact & Durable Design – Housed in a sturdy plastic case, making it lightweight and space-efficient.
  • Easy Power Supply – Operates with a 2-pin power adapter for convenient installation.
  • Quality Manufacturing – Produced in Lithuania, China, and Malaysia, ensuring high production standards.
  • 12-Month Warranty – Comes with a one-year limited warranty, ensuring reliable after-sales support.


Technical Specifications

  • Brand: MikroTik
  • Model: hEX S (RB760iGS)
  • CPU: Dual-Core 880MHz Processor
  • RAM: 256MB
  • Storage: 16MB Flash
  • Ethernet Ports: 5 x Gigabit LAN ports
  • SFP Port: 1 x SFP slot for fiber-optic connectivity
  • USB Port: 1 x USB for storage and external devices
  • PoE-Out: 1 x PoE-out on LAN Port #5
  • Operating System: RouterOS L4 License
  • Casing: Plastic
  • Power Adapter: 2-pin DC power adapter
  • Manufacturing Origin: Lithuania, China, Malaysia
  • Warranty: 12-Month Limited Warranty

Ideal Applications

  • Home & Small Business Networking – Ensures fast and secure connectivity for multiple devices.
  • Enterprise & Office Networks – Offers advanced routing and firewall capabilities.
  • Fiber-Optic Networking – Supports high-speed internet through SFP connectivity.
  • PoE-Enabled Devices – Powers IP cameras, access points, and VoIP phones without extra adapters.
  • Secure VPN & Firewall Setup – Ideal for remote access, corporate security, and data protection.


Why Choose MikroTik hEX S (RB760iGS)?

  • Gigabit Performance with Fiber Support – Fast, efficient, and future-proof.
  • Dual-Core Power with Advanced Features – Perfect for demanding network tasks.
  • PoE-Out for Flexible Device Integration – Saves power adapters and reduces cable clutter.
  • Compact, Reliable, & Energy-Efficient – Ideal for home and business users.
  • Budget-Friendly, Yet Feature-Rich – Affordable price without compromising performance.
